organization.name_ja: 株式会社サンリオエンターテイメント

affected.note: Up to about 2 million records of personal and other confidential information. Affected groups include Sanrio Puroland and Harmonyland annual passport holders, former Puroland fan club members, freelance contractors and employees (My Number for some contract and payroll records). Credit card data was not included. On 2025-08-12 Sanrio reported that the investigation was complete and no leak related to the incident had been confirmed.

summary.en: Sanrio Entertainment, which operates Sanrio Puroland, suffered a ransomware attack that caused network trouble from 2025-01-21. Parent company Sanrio announced that up to about 2 million records of personal and confidential information may have leaked; a later investigation found no confirmed leak.
summary.ja: サンリオピューロランドなどを運営するサンリオエンターテイメントがランサムウェアによる不正アクセスを受け、2025年1月21日からネットワーク障害が発生した。親会社のサンリオは個人情報や機密情報が最大約200万件外部へ漏えいした可能性があると公表し、その後の調査では漏えいは確認されなかった。
